name: SmartGlue public PLC communication contract
scope: contrato do simulador espelhando o ladder real (ADR-003); CLP nativo e máquina física exigem validação separada

encoding.M: Modbus coil at the numeric device address
encoding.D: Modbus holding register at the numeric device address
encoding.signed_dword: two 16-bit words, low word first, two's complement

watchdog.plc_source: COMANDOS_E_STATUS rede 22: TMR T450 K10 (base 100 ms)

target_out_of_range: satura no limite (ordem do ladder: máximo, depois mínimo) e o alvo saturado volta ao registrador de alvo

application.title: Aplicação
application.jog_speed_semantics: DJOG S2: pulsos/s com sinal; o sinal define o sentido (grave negativo nos registradores *_NEGATIVE). S1/S3 = rampas em unidades de 10 ms (0..3000).

inspection.title: Inspeção
inspection.jog_speed_semantics: módulo em speed_xy (X/Y) ou speed_z (Z) escrito antes do bit; sentido do bit

dispense.semantics: valve_request: level held high keeps the valve open (master times it); move_xy_dispense: rising edge, captures the MOVE_XY block and the retained leads, BUSY/DONE like MOVE_XY; FAULT, STOP or heartbeat loss close the valve and reopening needs the level back at 0; refused requests publish 1012 without FAULT

command_lifecycle: on done=1 and busy=0, read final state (a saturated target ends at the limit)
confirm done=0 before the next command
invariants: never infer completion from a delay
never send the next command before acknowledging done
never automatically retry an indeterminate motion
HOME has a duration (busy=1) and ends with done=1
